    # The 6 divider separates two binary patterns; retain matching occupied cells.
    marker = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 6 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:marker] for row in grid]
    right = [row[marker+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a == 5 and b == 5 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(left, right)]
